cta_caption: Comment FOLLOWERS aur main full guide DM kar dunga 📩

slides.headline: KEYWORD + [FOLLOW] GATE
slides.label: THE SYSTEM
lines: Keyword comment pe freebie, but **follow ke baad** hi DM mein milega.

slides.headline: STEP 1: [PROMISE]
slides.label: THE REEL
lines: Reel mein kuch **specific** promise karo: guide, **template** ya list.

slides.headline: STEP 2: [BOLO]
slides.label: SAY IT EARLY
lines: "Comment **GUIDE** and I'll DM it" **jaldi bolo** aur **caption** mein bhi daalo.

slides.headline: STEP 3: [UNLOCK]
slides.label: THE TOOL
lines: Comment-to-DM with **follow to unlock** set karo.

slides.headline: JO CHALE, [REPEAT]
slides.label: MEASURE
lines: Reel report mein **follows per 1,000 views** dekho aur best format **repeat** karo.
